specs_json.sensors: cameras + ultrasonic + radar + GNSS, ML-based perception
specs_json.autonomy_level: L4 sidewalk within service areas, remote oversight

notes: Gen 3 of world's largest sidewalk delivery fleet (millions of deliveries, campuses and grocery). Larger 1260 Wh pack gives ~12 h operation; wireless charging pads on newer deployments.

failure_modes.name: Wheel motor/hub failure from curb impacts
failure_modes.mitigation: curb-climb force monitoring, scheduled hub replacement, route grading to avoid hostile curbs

failure_modes.name: Battery capacity fade under daily deep-cycling
failure_modes.mitigation: opportunity charging between jobs, SoC window limits (20-90%), fleet battery health telemetry

failure_modes.name: Camera/sensor occlusion from rain, mud, snow spray
failure_modes.mitigation: hydrophobic coatings, operator-assist fallback, cleaning at hub each cycle

failure_modes.name: GNSS urban-canyon drift causing localization error
failure_modes.mitigation: vision-map matching priority in canyons, geofence review, remote op confirmation at crossings

failure_modes.name: Lid lock actuator failure
failure_modes.mitigation: lock cycle testing at depot, remote unlock fallback, actuator replacement schedule

failure_modes.name: Vandalism/theft attempts
failure_modes.mitigation: audible alarm + tracking, remote operator engagement, community reporting and geofenced no-go zones
